The papers, open datasets, and software behind the \acr{OPDI} — together with the open-source ecosystem the initiative is built upon.

## Methodology studies

Benchmarks of \acr{OPDI} algorithms against EUROCONTROL reference data. Each study reports what the comparison showed, including where a proposed method failed, and renders every figure from a committed cache so its results can be reproduced from the repository alone.

:::: {.publication-card}
::: {.publication-venue}
PRU<br>**2026**
:::
::: {.publication-info}
[Study]{.pill .pill-paper}

**[Detecting departure and destination aerodromes from ADS-B — version 4.1](../papers/adep-ades-detection-v4/index.html)** · [PDF](../papers/adep-ades-detection-v4/adep-ades-detection-v4.pdf)

EUROCONTROL Performance Review Unit

Detection moved inside the pipeline: H3 as the index, exact distance as the comparison, three modes behind one parameter. The detection radius turns out to barely matter for coverage while the abstention height decides almost everything — though on accuracy both axes pull the other way, which is what fixes the operating point. Earlier versions remain published: [v1](../papers/adep-ades-detection/index.html), [v2](../papers/adep-ades-detection-v2/index.html), [v3](../papers/adep-ades-detection-v3/index.html).
:::
::::

:::: {.publication-card}
::: {.publication-venue}
PRU<br>**2026**
:::
::: {.publication-info}
[Study]{.pill .pill-paper}

**[Detecting departure and destination aerodromes from ADS-B — version 1](../papers/adep-ades-detection/index.html)** · [PDF](../papers/adep-ades-detection/adep-ades-detection.pdf)

EUROCONTROL Performance Review Unit

A comparison of seven \acr{ADEP}/\acr{ADES} methodologies against APDF ground truth over two three-day samples a year apart. Finds that the production algorithm's altitude-trend logic contributes no accuracy over a nearest-aerodrome rule on the same flights, and that replacing it with explicit endpoint abstention improves departure detection by 8–10 points of coverage — while the same change fails to replicate for arrivals.
:::
::::

**[The Open Performance Data Initiative: A Foundation Supporting the European Open Science Alliance for ATM Research](https://www.sesarju.eu/sites/default/files/documents/sid/2024/papers/SIDs_2024_paper_100%20final.pdf)**

Q. Goens, R. Koelle, E. Spinielli, T. Bolić, A. Cook, M. Strohmeier

*SESAR Innovation Days 2024*

## OPDI Software

Open-source projects created and maintained by the \acr{PRC} as part of the initiative.

:::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang}

**[OPDI](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/opdi)**

A pip-installable Python package for processing \acr{OSN} aviation data through modular ETL pipelines. This is the code underpinning the OPDI datasets — see the [Methodology](methodology.qmd) for how each dataset is derived.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/opdi) · [{{< iconify fa6-solid book >}} Documentation](https://euctrl-pru.github.io/OPDI/)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang}

**[HexAeroPy](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/HexAeroPy)**

Determines the airports, runways, taxiways, and stands used by a flight from its coordinates alone. Developed for small-scale applications of the OPDI runway-detection approach.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/euctrl-pru/HexAeroPy)
:::
::::

## Open-Source Foundations

The \acr{OPDI} would not be possible without the wider open aviation software community. These projects are used throughout the data pipeline and the methodologies.

:::: {.project-card .project-dependency}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang} [MIT]{.pill .pill-licence}

**[traffic](https://traffic-viz.github.io/)**

A toolbox for processing and analysing air traffic data. Used for trajectory filtering and cleaning.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/xoolive/traffic) · [{{< iconify fa6-solid book >}} Documentation](https://traffic-viz.github.io/)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card .project-dependency}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang} [LGPL-3.0]{.pill .pill-licence}

**[OpenAP](https://openap.dev/)**

The open model for aircraft performance and emissions, by [Dr. Junzi Sun](https://junzis.com/) of TU Delft. Used to classify state vectors into flight phases when deriving flight events.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/junzis/openap) · [{{< iconify fa6-solid book >}} Documentation](https://openap.dev/)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card .project-dependency}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang} [LGPL-3.0]{.pill .pill-licence}

**[pyopensky](https://mode-s.org/pyopensky/)**

The Python interface to the \acr{OSN} database, providing access to state vectors and historical trajectories via the REST API and Trino.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/open-aviation/pyopensky) · [{{< iconify fa6-solid book >}} Documentation](https://mode-s.org/pyopensky/)
:::
::::

:::: {.project-card .project-dependency}
::: {.project-info}
[Python]{.pill .pill-lang} [LGPL-3.0]{.pill .pill-licence}

**[fastmeteo](https://github.com/open-aviation/fastmeteo)**

A fast tool for obtaining meteorological data along flight trajectories. Used to associate weather information with trajectory points.

[{{< iconify fa6-brands github >}} Repository](https://github.com/open-aviation/fastmeteo)
:::
::::

## Contributing

If you maintain an open-source project that builds on OPDI data, or would like to contribute to one of ours, we would like to hear from you. Contact us at [pru-support@eurocontrol.int](mailto:pru-support@eurocontrol.int).
